title: Motion-Picture Film (8-mm Type R) - Length of Film on Camera Spools - 25-Ft Capacity
scope: and purpose 1.1 Scope This standard describes the total length and the photographically useful length of raw film supplied on an 8-mm type R motion-picture camera spool of 25-ft (7.6-m) nominal capacity. 1.2 Purpose The propose of this standard is to provide a uniform basis for the operation of automatic or nonadjustable footage counters in cameras.
